chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: Singing with Slam; later Cleveland engagement
summary: He sang a little harmony and became the comedian of the trio; after the Three Deuces they played Chin's in Cleveland.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: A little, 'cause I had been with the GF + I could sing harmonies, but like I wasn't a showman see Slim, I mean how do you follow him. Not me... Not at that particular time. But I wound up being another Redd Foxx and everything else. Tell jokes, dance, sing do everything else.
How did you travel with Tatum?

Train. We didn't do that much traveling. We stayed at places so long. After the 3 Peaces I think we went to Cleveland, and played at a place called Chin's. I think a Chinese place. We even broadcast from there. We stayed there quite a while. But we never got to Toledo, his home, I don't know why. We went to Chicago.
